gaps.title: Compliance page renders 100% fabricated ANAF/GDPR/SOC2 statuses and declarations
gaps.detail: Page has zero API calls. Hardcoded `complianceItems` (e-Factura 'Conform', SAF-T 'Conform', REVISAL warning, all dated 2024-12-14) and `declarations` (D406/D112/D100/D394 for Nov 2024) drive the 'Scor Conformitate' gradient card, 4 KPI tiles, per-category progress bars, a 'Depune' button per fake declaration, and a calendar tab hardcoded to 'Decembrie 2024 / Ianuarie 2025'. Linked from MobileBottomNav as 'Rapoarte' and from DashboardClient module nav, so every mobile user lands here and sees 'Toate sistemele verificate' regardless of their real SPV state. 'Raport Audit' and 'Verificare Completă' buttons do nothing.
gaps.fix_spec: Replace static arrays with fetches: GET /api/v1/compliance/anaf-status/overview (+ /dashboard) for e-Factura/SAF-T/D112/D394 submission state; GET /api/v1/compliance/calendar/upcoming?days=30, /compliance/calendar/overdue, /compliance/calendar/stats and GET /api/v1/deadlines/summary for declarations/calendar tabs (render real months from today, not Dec 2024); GET /api/v1/compliance/dashboard (SOC2 controls) and GET /api/v1/gdpr/consents for the GDPR/SOC2 categories. Compute complianceScore from those responses; wire 'Depune' to router.push('/dashboard/e-invoice' | '/dashboard/saft') by code; on fetch error show loadError banner + empty state (reuse pattern from anaf-status/page.tsx). Delete the hardcoded arrays.

gaps.title: Quality dashboard never calls the backend — every tab shows an error/empty state even when data exists
gaps.detail: fetchData() has all six fetches commented out (TODO lines 215-263) and unconditionally calls loadEmpty() which sets loadError=true. Users with real inspections/NCRs/CAPAs (created via the working detail pages quality/inspections/[id], ncr/[id], capa/[id]) see a permanent 'could not load' state and zero KPI tiles (summary stays null). The commented URLs (/quality/summary, /quality/ncr, /quality/capa, /quality/suppliers) also do not match real routes.
gaps.fix_spec: Wire to existing endpoints: GET /api/v1/quality-inspections (list) + /quality-inspections/metrics; GET /api/v1/non-conformance?status=OPEN + /non-conformance/metrics; GET /api/v1/capa + /capa/metrics; GET /api/v1/quality-documents; GET /api/v1/supplier-quality + /supplier-quality/metrics; build `summary` (openNCRs/totalNCRs/pendingCAPAs/resolvedCAPAs/inspectionPassRate/totalInspections) from the metrics responses, or use GET /api/v1/quality-kpis. Use localStorage 'auth_token' (page currently reads 'token', which is the wrong key). Set loadError only when a request actually fails; replace the 'TODO Recharts' placeholder with a real chart from /quality-analytics/trend/:metric or remove it.

gaps.title: GDPR console shows fabricated data-subject requests with fake personal names instead of real DSRs
gaps.detail: No API calls. Hardcoded `dsrRequests` (Maria Ionescu, Andrei Popescu, Elena Dumitrescu, Ion Georgescu with emails), `consentRecords`, `dataInventory`, `auditLogs`, `dsrTypeData`, `dsrMonthlyData` feed every tab, KPI counts (pending/in-progress/completed) and both charts. A DPO opening this sidebar page cannot see or process real DSR requests submitted via the public GDPR form, and the 30-day legal deadline counters are fiction.
gaps.fix_spec: Wire: GET /api/v1/gdpr/dsr-requests (list, Prisma dSRRequest) with PATCH /api/v1/gdpr/dsr-requests/:id for status changes; GET /api/v1/gdpr/consents and /api/v1/gdpr/consent-log for the consent tab; GET /api/v1/gdpr/data-inventory for the inventory tab; derive dsrTypeData/dsrMonthlyData client-side from the real list. For the audit-log tab call GET /api/v1/audit?entity=gdpr (audit controller) or hide the tab. Empty state: 'Nicio cerere DSR înregistrată'. Remove all fake personal data.

gaps.title: AI assistant fabricates financial 'analysis' of the user's data via setTimeout + canned text
gaps.detail: handleSend never calls the backend: after 1.5s it appends getSimulatedResponse(), which returns hardcoded figures presented as the user's own numbers ('Venituri totale: 245.890 RON', '+12.3%', category breakdowns, ANAF deadlines). `sampleHistory` shows four fake past conversations. The page is in the sidebar and GlobalSearch, and DashboardClient routes users here with their question (?q=). A freelancer asking 'Analizează veniturile' gets invented revenue.
gaps.fix_spec: Wire to POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/chat (body {message, conversationId?}) or POST /api/v1/ai-assistant/query, and GET /api/v1/ai-assistant/conversations for history (POST /ai-assistant/conversations to create). Remove getSimulatedResponse and sampleHistory; while waiting show typing indicator; on error show 'Asistentul AI este indisponibil momentan' — never a fabricated answer. Also fix DashboardClient.tsx handleAskAI which POSTs to nonexistent /api/v1/ai/assistant — just router.push to the assistant with ?q= and let this page send it.

gaps.title: Main dashboard shows fabricated cash-flow and VAT charts as placeholder, on 401, on empty payload and on error
gaps.detail: useDashboardSummary sets placeholderData = {cashFlow: fallbackCashFlow (45k-67k RON/month), vatSummary: fallbackVatData (12.600/8.400/4.200 RON)}, returns the same fallback when /dashboard/summary returns 401 or an empty body, and DashboardClient.tsx line 608-609 falls back again (`dashboardData?.cashFlow || fallbackCashFlow`). Because placeholderData makes isLoading false, a brand-new account sees a confident 6-month revenue chart and VAT pie of invented numbers on first paint and permanently if the API errors.
gaps.fix_spec: Backend GET /api/v1/dashboard/summary exists — drop placeholderData (or use empty arrays), return {cashFlow: [], vatSummary: [], ...zeros} on 401/empty, and in DashboardClient.tsx replace the || fallbacks with `dashboardData?.cashFlow ?? []` plus an explicit empty-chart state ('Nu există date încă — emite prima factură') and an error banner using the query's isError. Delete fallbackCashFlow/fallbackVatData from both files.

gaps.title: Billing page tells every user they are on the 149 RON 'Business' plan with fake invoices and usage

gaps.title: HSE dashboard mixes real risk/audit data with mock incidents and invented safety/environmental KPIs
